sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Radioligand binding ([3H]diprenorphine, Kd 1.1 nM, Bmax 2.6 pmoles/mg) confirmed surface display; G-protein coupling and MAP kinase (ERK) phosphorylation following agonist activation confirmed downstream signaling — function preserved.
sites.rationale: All seven ledger lines describe N-terminal tags on full-length, membrane-anchored KOR; no residue number is named in any clip, but the N-terminus is the only extracellular terminus available for a prepend tag (topology: residues 1–57 extracellular, no signal peptide, so residue 1 M is the mature start). Python confirmed seq[0]='M' and the TM1 boundary begins at residue 58 (seq[57]='I'), placing the prepend 57 residues from the nearest TM helix — well beyond the ≥3-residue minimum. L2 provides the strongest quantitative surface evidence (binding assay); L3 confirms G-protein and MAP kinase signaling; L4–L7 independently replicate N-terminal tagging with SpH, FLAG, and HA in three cell lines. FLAG epitope tag inserted at the amino terminus of full-length rat kappa-opioid receptor (rKOR) stably expressed in HEK293 cells. [3H]diprenorphine binding confirmed surface expression (Kd = 1.1 ± 0.2 nM, Bmax = 2.6 ± 0.4 pmoles/mg protein). Rat KOR is a close ortholog of human OPRK1; the extracellular N-terminus is conserved in topology. Multiple independent studies (L1–L7) corroborate N-terminal tagging of full-length KOR with FLAG, SpH/GFP, and HA in HEK293, PC12, and CHO cells.

sources.claim: A clonal HEK 293 cell line was established that stably expressed rKOR with a FLAG tag at the amino terminus. [ 3 H]Diprenorphine bound to the epitope-tagged receptor with an apparent dissociation constant (K d ) of 1.1 ± 0.2 nM, and the maximum number of binding sites (B max ) was 2.6 ± 0.4 pmoles/mg protein ( Fig. 1A ).

literature_notes: All seven ledger lines converge on a single site: the extracellular N-terminus of full-length KOR (insert_after_residue=0). No ledger line names a specific residue number, so position_evidence is topology_derived — the N-terminus is the sole extracellular terminus available for a prepend. L1–L3 use rat KOR (close ortholog, labelled indirect); L4–L7 describe KOR without explicit species but in the same N-terminal prepend configuration. The C-terminal Venus fusion reported in L7 is intracellular (topology residues 334–380) and is recorded in other_positions. No ledger line supports any internal ECL site (ECL1 120–132, ECL2 197–222, ECL3 297–311) with a tolerated insertion, so none are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: Venus fluorescent protein fragments (VN/VC) fused to the C-terminus of full-length KOR in HEK293 cells; the C-terminus falls in the intracellular domain (topology residues 334–380), making this an intracellular label, not a surface tag.
